run_fuse_gmock_files_cli: run fuse_gmock_files.py with an output directory to fuse gmock and gtest source files
run_fuse_gmock_with_root: run fuse_gmock_files.py with a custom gmock root directory and output directory
fuse_gmock_all: call FuseGMock to fuse gtest.h, gmock.h, and gmock-gtest-all.cc into an output directory
fuse_gmock_h: call FuseGMockH to scan gmock_root and generate a fused gmock/gmock.h header file
validate_gmock_root_dir: call ValidateGMockRootDir to verify a gmock root directory contains required seed files
